title: The Lanes at Christmas
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The bowling alley hangs a wreath on the sign's S. All the letters lit, and a wreath. Wood draws the sign for the second time this year. He's started keeping a count of the letters without knowing why.

panels.composition: SMALL WOOD LANES at night, every letter lit, a wreath hung on the S. Snowless. Rain.

image.prompt: a bowling alley's roofline neon sign fully lit at night with a wreath hung on its first letter, rain falling, black and white, no words
image.notes: All letters lit. The S: the first to go dark, Nov 2010. Not yet.

panels.composition: The S with the wreath. Lit through the greenery.

image.prompt: close on a lit neon letter with a holiday wreath hung over it, black and white, no words

panels.composition: WOOD across the road with the pad. BARNABY. The pad: the sign, and under it a row of fifteen small marks. All filled in.

image.prompt: a young man across a highway drawing a lit neon sign on a pad, a row of fifteen small tally marks beneath the drawing, a dog beside him, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood walking home, the sign behind. Fifteen. The strip keeps the count from now on and never says why.

image.prompt: a young man and a dog walking away from a lit neon sign along a wet highway shoulder at night, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: Fifteen marks, all filled. The count begins; the reason is 2010.
